Go to your PluginManager and open up mog's plugin. On the right side, loo for the parameter named "Com Name X-Axis". Change that value to a lower number and it should fix its placement. The name is centered so find a value that fits the screen best.

that parameter is for something else-
The command name adds a 2nd name for the option you are hovering in the menu, i had it disabled previously since i didn't want that little floating part.
Some of the more specific things you want to change in this plugin, you have to do in the actual javascript file itself, like the menu options there on the left, by default they are horizontal.
